biography_english:
A Galgastani who served his clan in battle. During the reign of King Dorgalua, deadly swordfights were a popular form of entertainment among wealthy Bakram in Heim. Only gladiators were permitted to participate in these bouts to the death. These gladiators were deserters or criminals chosen for their fighting ability. By choosing the path of the gladiator they escaped execution and were granted a small chance of freedom.
  Brezen was once a gladiator himself, surviving numerous bouts to eventually win his liberty. His skill in battle saw him recruited into the army, but he was disliked by others for his vulgar manners. He was bullied mercilessly and made the target of much unjustified scorn. Perhaps because of this, his prowess on the field of battle waned.
  He was killed after clashing with {hero} Pavel on the Golborza Plain.
biography_spanish:
Un galgastani que sirvio a su clan en batalla. En el reinado del rey Dorgalua, los combates de espada mortales eran un entretenimiento popular entre los ricos bakram de Heim. Solo los gladiadores podian participar en estos duelos a muerte. Estos gladiadores eran desertores o criminales elegidos por su habilidad de combate. Al elegir el camino del gladiador escapaban de la ejecucion y obtenian una escasa opcion de libertad.
  Brezen fue gladiador, y tras sobrevivir a varios duelos al fin gano su libertad. Su destreza en batalla hizo que lo reclutaran en el ejercito, pero no agradaba a los demas por sus modales vulgares. Sufrio acoso sin piedad y fue blanco de desprecio injustificado. Quizas por esto, su destreza en el campo de batalla decayo.
  Fue abatido tras enfrentarse a {hero} Pavel en la Llanura de Golborza.

biography_english: An enigmatic young woman. She was seen using an artifact of some kind at the Palace of the Dead, but her identity remains a mystery. She does not seem to be affiliated with any particular faction. She appears to have an understanding of the power that flows throughout the Palace of the Dead.
biography_spanish: Una joven enigmatica. Fue vista usando un artefacto de cierto tipo en el Palacio de los Muertos, pero su identidad sigue siendo un misterio. No parece estar afiliada a ninguna faccion en particular. Parece comprender el poder que fluye por todo el Palacio de los Muertos.

biography_english:
An enigmatic young woman. Little is known of her except that she was not human, having taken possession of the body she inhabited. She is thought to have been a guardian of Ashmedai's palace―the Palace of the Dead―as she was conversant with the forces of chaos, and liches and other undead did her bidding.
  She was slain after a number of clashes with Resistance forces. However, if her final words are to be believed, her soul will live on beyond the loss of her corporeal form.
biography_spanish:
Una joven enigmatica. Poco se sabe de ella salvo que no era humana, tras haber tomado posesion del cuerpo que habitaba. Se cree que era guardiana del palacio de Ashmedai―el Palacio de los Muertos―ya que conocia las fuerzas del caos, y liches y otros no muertos obedecian sus ordenes.
  Fue abatida tras varios enfrentamientos con fuerzas de la Resistencia. Sin embargo, si se cree en sus ultimas palabras, su alma vivira mas alla de la perdida de su forma corporea.
